segments.text: It must also ask what happens

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: person tries to return to family

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: That is where the Dangerous Drugs

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: this side of the drug problem is

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: niya ay tulong para sa anak niya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Its role is to help government

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: That may not always be the most

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: then we do not yet have

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: DDB exists to help bring those

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: and they also show why sustained

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: That decline is encouraging. Pero hindi ibig sabihin na pwede na tayong maging kampante.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Mahigit isang milyong Pilipino pa rin yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: And not every person in that number needs the same intervention.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Others may be better served through community-based rehabilitation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: May iba na ang kailangan ay continuing support para hindi bumalik sa dating sitwasyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: So the task is broader than simply counting facilities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: The value of DDB's coordinating role is to help government understand what kind of help is needed,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: where it is needed, and how people can actually reach it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: For Fiscal Year 2027, the Dangerous Drugs Board has a proposed total agency budget of P526.54 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: In Fiscal Year 2026, its total agency budget was P598.17 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: That is a reduction of P71.62 million, or approximately 12%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Its new general appropriations amount to P418.14 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: So this is not an agency asking for a large expansion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Sa totoo lang, mas maliit pa ang kabuang budget na hinihingi para sa susunod na taon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: But DDB is still being asked to coordinate a broad national strategy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: That is why the proposed amount is reasonable.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Within the Fiscal Year 2027 proposal, P169.18 million is allocated to the Drug Abuse Prevention and Control Program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Of this amount, P111.69 million is for policy formulation, surveys, research, and studies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Another P32.84 million is for advocacy and information programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: And P24.64 million is for capacity building.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: The size of the allocation for research and policy deserves context.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: This spending is justified when it gives government a clearer basis for where and how to intervene.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Kung hindi natin alam kung nasaan ang problema, paano natin malalaman kung saan ilalagay ang pera.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Kung hindi natin alam kung aling programa ang gumagana, baka taon-taon lang tayong gumagastos dahil nakasanayan na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: At kung hindi natin alam kung ano ang nangyayari pagkatapos ng treatment, paano natin malalaman kung talagang nagkaroon ng recovery.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Because research has a value, or research has value when it guides actual decisions to guide us for future allocation of resources.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: It should help identify where more treatment is needed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: It should show where community-based programs should be expanded.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: It should guide where prevention should be strengthened.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: And it should help Congress and the executive identify which interventions are producing the best results.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: That is where DDB adds value as a policy and coordinating institution.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: This becomes even more important when we talk about rehabilitation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: The Department of Health is in the best position to tell Congress the actual treatment capacity of the country.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Available beds, occupancy, waiting lists, outpatient services, personnel, equipment,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: DDB should help bring all of that information together under one national strategy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: DOH handles much of the health and treatment side.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Other agencies help with social support.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Kaya mahalaga na may isang malinaw na direksyon at isang national strategy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Maraming ahensya rin ang may pondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Ang tungkulin ng DDB ay tulungang pagdugtungin ang mga ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Para sa dulo, malinaw kung paano nagkakaugnay-ugnay ang mga programa

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: at kung paano nito matutulungan o natutulungan ang Pilipinong nangayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: At kung paano nito nangangailangan ng servisyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: That is the value of a strong coordinating institution.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: And one reason DDB's capacity deserves continued support.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: The NEP also recognizes that rehabilitation funding extends beyond DDB's regular appropriation

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: with statutory funding sources involving PCSO and Pagco revenues for rehabilitation activities

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: The purpose of these funding streams is to translate appropriations into services that people can actually reach.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Doon dapat makita ang halaga ng pondo kung maaabot ang servisyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Kung may nanay sa probinsya na gustong ipagamot ang anak niya, dapat may malinaw siyang mapupuntahan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Kung natapos ang rehab, dapat may support sa pagbalik sa komunidad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: At kung may community-based program, alam natin dapat kung alin ang talagang efektibo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Those are the outcomes this budget should help government deliver.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, a credible anti-drug policy has to know the difference between those who profit from illegal drugs

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: and those who are trying to free themselves from dependence.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Sa taong gustong magbago, may tulong at may daan pabalik.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: And between those two responsibilities, enforcement on one side, recovery on the other,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: we need policy that connects the work of government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: So the purpose of this budget is not simply to maintain an office.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: It is to maintain the institution that helps government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: To prevent our problem and respond to it as one.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Fewer Filipino harmed by illegal drugs and more Filipinos given a real chance to recover.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Yan ang mahalagang trabaho ng DDB.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: And for these reasons, I rise to sponsor and respectfully urge this House to approve the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget of the Dangerous Drugs Board.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So kung may shift in framework, dapat po magkaroon nyo ng translation in budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At kung may kakayahan ng... at dapat po may kakayahan yung Dangerous Drugs Board na ipastol.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Yung iba't-ibang ahensya na ilagay po yung pera na ito instead sa further criminalization sa pagrespeto ng karapatang pantao,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: sa paggawa ng more drug facilities, no, and iba't-ibang mga pangailangan para harapin ito through a health-centric lens,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: yun po sana yung gusto natin mangyari.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So ang last request na lang po, Madam, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, ay once available yung e-pads,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ang po ang representasyon ng kopya na ito alongside nga po yung request natin na yung 2018 pads ay maisumiti rin

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: at yung report po ng konsultasyon ng mga organisasyon na nakausap, pati na rin po kung paano po ito makukonsulta pa sila

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: given na may target nga po na this year po siya lumabas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: We will ask the concerned agencies, Mr. Speaker, to comply immediately with the requested information.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, hindi lang yung shift in terms of budget allocation, ang dapat makita yung shift in the policy correspondingly the budget allocation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: but also the result that we are expecting from the agency, and that is what we are also demanding from the agency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Gusto lang ipabahagi lang ito, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Mr. Speaker ng DDB, yung supply reduction natin, yung budget ay mas mababa with 42% po against dun sa demand reduction po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Ito yung isang sinasabi nila na against 57% dun sa budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Ito yung sinasabi nila na nag-shift na tayo konti-konti dun sa budget natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Correspondingly or relative to the shift in policy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: At ito rin yung gusto rin ng DDB nga na may-access yung mga services galing sa iba pang mga agency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Sa DOH, sa DepEd, sa CHED, sa DSWD, dahil ang budget ay malaki naman talaga kung may ko-coordinate at may uugnay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Tulad ng aking pinaliwanag kanina sa aking sponsorship speech,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: ang malaking gawain ng DDB ay makapag-ugnay ng mga pangangailangan nito sa iba't ibang ahensya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: And it can be done through the board having different representation coming from the various departments of the government.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
segments.text: Thank you very much, Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ernesto "Ernix" Dionisio Jr.
segments.text: Next, to interpolate the sponsor, I move that we recognize Representative Iris Marie de Mesa Montes of Partylist 4K.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
segments.text: Representative Montes is recognized. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Distinguished sponsor to the DDB, magandang umaga po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ilang katanungan lamang po mula sa kababaihan, kabalikatan para sa kapakanan at kaundaran ng bayan o 4K.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Maaari po bang malaman ang tunay na estrado?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Nang problema ng droga sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Paano nyo po ito mailalarawan ngayon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: It's a work in progress po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Tulad po ng pinapaliwanag natin, ang pangunahin natin problema ay yung data po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Dahil nga po, 35 pa lamang LGU ang online na may access tayo doon sa impormasyon sa kanilang lugar.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Wala pa rito yung hindi pa lahat ng syudad sa Metro Manila, alimbawa, ay naka-access tayo doon sa impormasyon na kailangan natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Yung report po na nanggagaling doon sa mga barangay, sa mga badak na tinatawag po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Ang prevalence rate po natin buhad po noong 2019 hanggang 2023, batay po doon sa survey na ginawa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Pero ito'y datos po, numero po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Maaring may mga kulang o kaya may dagdag.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Ibig sabihin, noong panahon na yun, ayon doon sa survey,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Isang milyon at apat na daan at pitumpot siyam, ho, na katao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: 16.6% ang drop na nangyari o pagbaba doon sa current drug use prevalence na tinatawag.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: In a snapshot, parang ganito mo lang may papaliwanag.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Pero iba, siyempre, pag pinakinggan natin yung mga kwento,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: yung mga sinasabi ng mga kapitbahay natin, yung mga taga-barangay,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: ito yung gusto natin i-capture o pulihin para makina natin ng totoo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: At mangyayari lang yun kung may mga tamang informasyon tayo magagaling at the barangay level.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: And that's the reason why we have an...

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, ibig sabihin po, Mr. Speaker, sa kasalukuyan, napakahirap natin ma-determine or ma-measure exactly

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: kung bumababa ang antas ng prevalence ng droga despite reports that, say, madaming nasamsam,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: may mga na-aresto, libo-libo, o madami nang nadeklarang drug pi-barangay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, in fact, are we saying now that...

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Yung mga ganong klaseng pagtingin ay hindi talaga nakabatay sa datos

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Dahil wala tayong effective measure o wala tayong sapat na basihan sa pagsabi o sa pag-claim na bumaba na nga ang incidence, mas konti ang gumagamit, bumaba ang supply, mga ganong bagay po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Yung validation is a continuing process po. Ang pinapahayag po natin ngayon, malinaw po, nakabatay dun sa survey na ginawa po, this is a national household survey in 2023, ay may 16.6% na pagbaba po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Ayun po yung sinasabi po natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Tulad po ng pinaliwanag ko kanina, yung bilang ng pagbaba po, pwede po natin sabihin may konting improvement po sa isang bahagi po dahil bumaba po yung drug use prevalence.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: But what we're pointing at, and more importantly, is that meron pa rin isang milyon at apat na daang drug.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: At hindi po tulad na sinabi ko kanina sa aking sponsorship speech, hindi po natin pinagwawalang bahala po yung 1.4 milyon na yun dahil isang milyon pa rin Pilipino yun, isang milyon pa rin pamilya ang apektado.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: At ang problema po ng droga ay hindi problema ng individual, hindi problema ng buong pamilya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: At maaring hindi po lang isang pamilya lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: So, baka ng buong komunidad na kung saan naroon po yung drug user.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: We recognize the fact that treatment should be readily, immediately, humanely accessible to every Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: That's the problem. Ang tingin po namin ay yun po yung malaking problema ngayon. Access to treatment and rehabilitation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: And that's the reason why we are...

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Calling the attention or there should be priority in terms of the budget of the Department of Health.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Kasi yung treatment po eh, yun po ang nagiging malaking problema.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: At hindi pa po natin na ipa-factor in yung recurring, yung bumabalik po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Dahil sakit nga po ito eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Yun din po yung data na hinahanap natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: That's why almost 40% of the budget of DDB is allocated for the research and survey so that we could establish the proper data po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Yes, exactly Mr. Chair, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Yan po talaga ang gusto kong tumbukin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Kasi paano kasi natin masusukat po ang pulisiya, ang effectiveness?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: How do we measure the effectiveness of the policies of the DDB?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Wala nga po tayong quantifiable or tamang sukatan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Kasi it will bring us to later on yung problema kung paano natin maipapababa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: How do we know exactly in real terms na napababa na natin ang prevalence kung hindi po natin nasusukat,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: kung effective yung ating pulisiya after all pala po ang mga pulisiya natin at hindi angkop.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Kasi wala po tayong metrics o wala po tayong tamang pagtingin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Sa tamang datos on the ground, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: I would agree Mr. Speaker very much with your observation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Kaya nga yung survey research study natin sa DDB, nag-allocate tayo ng 111.69 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Mag-allocate o mag-alagay ng pondo dahil nakasanayan na lamang o kaya may nag-propose from the board.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Ang tulad ng pinaliwanag natin kanina, ang pagbabudget o allocation of funds sa DDB,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: ginagawa based on drug use prevalence kung ano yung saan lugar pinakamalala at anong klase.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: And then, yung inyong sa muntsa po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Affectation po, yung affectation na sinasabi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Kung mapapansin niyo rin po, yung mga tulong po natin doon sa pagtatayo ng mga rehab center,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: hindi po ito dahil kilala o malakas yung isang kinatawan o mayor ng lugar.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Kaya magkakaroon sila ng rehab treatment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Pero ito po, alimbawa, las piñas, meron po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Pero hindi po dahil malakas ang kinatawan ng las piñas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Galing po ito sa DOH po, hindi po galing sa DDB.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Pero based on the prioritization, yung affectation, kung saan kailangan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: pati doon nilalagay yung mga rehab center natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Pero kulang na kulang po, imagine, isipin po natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: 60 milyon ang nilalaan para sa mga rehab, para lang sa pagpapatayo ng mga istruktura.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Para sa buong bansa, sa higit isang libong probinsya at mga munisipilidad at syudad,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: The problem really, Mr. Speaker, is the access to treatment rehab.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Yes, actually, yan na po ang susunod kong katanungan tungkol sa treatment, rehabilitation, preventive education,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: mga polisiya na atin pong binabalangka sa DDB that will address preventive education, treatment, and rehabilitation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Alam ko pong very challenging for the DDB, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Especially with the fragmentation na meron tayo, it seems like efforts are not coordinated.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: You have DOH and what not, pinapaliwanag niyo po kanina.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, iyon din po ang gusto kong maitanong, ano po ba kaya ang pwede nating magawang polisiya within the DDB

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: so that clear ang mga roles ng mga agencies, coordinated ang efforts natin in terms of education, rehabilitation, and treatment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Meron na po ba tayong mga policies in the DDB that will set the tone kung paano gagampanan ng mga ahensya

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ang dapat nilang gampanan within the context or framework po na nga pag-insure na napapanitilip, mapapanatilip, o magagawa po nating drug-free ang ating...

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Kasama na po, of course, dyan po, siyempre.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ang kadalasan pong nangyayari, marirehab ng ilang buwan, lalabas ng ilang buwan, babalik na naman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Dahil, yung ating mga programa ay tingin po natin ay hindi sapat para to sustain yung treatment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, in the end, nagsasayang lang po tayo ng oras at pondo kasi hindi talaga natin na natitreat or naririsolva yung ating problema, mister.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Tama po kayo. Sayang po talaga, pondo, kung hindi po gumaling yung pumasok sa treatment or rehab facility.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Ang pinakamalungkot po, nasundan ba natin yung nagamot na?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Hindi lang basta po na rehab. Our concern, practically, is na baka nakakalimutan po ng marami ay yung reintegration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Nakabalik po ba siya doon sa normal niyang...

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Kaya po, ito yung dahilan. Gusto natin magkaroon ng isang dashboard na mumumonitor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Buhat nung magkaroon ng addiction, tulad po ng pinapaliwanag ko kanina, ano nangyari kaya nung siya ay magamot na?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Nakabalik ba siya sa paaralan? Nakabalik ba siya sa kanyang trabaho?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Ito po yung mga impormasyon na kailangan po natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: At ito po yung dahilan bakit may DDB. At ito po ang dahilan bakit interagency po ang composition ng board nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: I think the answer lies with the board of the DDB.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Kung paano sila gagawa ng isang implementing rules or regulation, a mechanism, not simply to address one part of the problem.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: For example, in 2019 po, may board.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Board Regulation No. 7 po ang DDB.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Nag-establish ng intervention mechanism for referral to treatment po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Pero kung regulation for referral, pero ang tanong is, is there an actual facility where a drug user can be admitted?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Yung gap kanina sinasabi ko sa kakulangan po ng pasilidad at ng treatment facility.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Meron po tayong education program na itinakdana ng batas, yung Republic Act 9165.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Napakatagal na po nitong batas ito, 2002 pa ho.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Pero ano na kaya nangyayari po rito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Ang problema is yung oversight po siguro.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Siguro, through the Committee on Dangerous Drugs of this Congress, we could help DDB to rationalize the programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: How to coordinate efforts that we have.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Tandaan po natin, ang DDB ay isang ano lamang, isang board.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Ang kaharap niya at ang kasama niya sa board na yon ay mga alter ego ng presidente.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Tulad nitong karanasan na huli ng DDB.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Ang Department of Health para sa mga treatment facilities natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Pero hindi napopondohan ng tama at hindi priority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: I think this Congress could help through the Committee on Dangerous Drugs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: The coordination problem of DDB, of the agencies on how to fully, to have a functional, pragmatic mechanism.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Considering, yung not only demand, supply reduction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Importantly, yung delivery of health, social development services.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: at siguro dapat nasasalamin din sa pulisiya ng DDB, atong mga batas na po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Kaugnay po doon sa mga dinedeklarang mga

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Pero hindi natin alam kung ano na

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: natin ano na po ba ang

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ito? O sapat na po bang

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: kung ano nga ba ang katunay na

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: kalagayan na ng barangay a year

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ganyan? Siya po ba ay bumalik?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: to do is to strengthen our

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: mga polisiyang to. And of course,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Hindi ibig sabihin na pag-araw na ito

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: o buwan na ito, na i-declare na

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: drug-free pa rin siya. I would

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: government, we should have a whole

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Pati ang mga barangay ay kasama rito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Paano kung ang barangay ang hindi nagde-declare

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: ng mga nagagamot na at gumaling na?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Yun nga lang, ito ay nasa pamamahala ng Department of Health.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Kaya yung tanong, kung meron silang data, meron silang report,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro

segments.text: when we talk about illegal drugs, we can easily get lost in numbers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: bago pa umabot ang droga sa aming barangay?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: That is the public purpose behind the budget

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: of the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: And the problem PIDEA is dealing with today

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: is very different from what it was

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Illegal drugs are no longer moving only from one street to another.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Drug syndicates now operate across borders.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: They use commercial cargo planes, airports, international parcels,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: ports, coastlines, and the open sea.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Nagbabago sila ng modus, nagbabago sila ng paraan ng pagtatago.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: sa isang modus, lilipat sila sa iba.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: So the government must be able to adapt just as quickly.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: That is where PIDEA has a very specific role.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: The law mandates PIDEA to conduct anti-drug operations and intelligence work.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: It identifies high-value personalities and organizations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: It coordinates interdiction efforts with other agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Its job is to make it harder

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: for illegal drugs to enter, circulate, and reach our communities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: And we have seen how serious that task has become.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: PIDEA itself has identified airports, seaports, coastlines,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: and mail and parcel systems as major entry points for illegal drugs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: It also documented the June 2025 interdiction off Subic,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: This is no longer a street-level drug crime.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Kapag ganito kalaki ang shipment, malinaw may organisasyon sa likod nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: May pera, may logistics, may intelligence, may network.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: PIDEA is proposed to receive 4.41 billion in new general appropriations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: This is not an extravagant request.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: It is a measured allocation for an agency

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: whose responsibilities are becoming more complex.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: And the way the budget is structured also tells us something important.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: The Dangerous Drug Supply Reduction and Suppression Program

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: while anti-drug operations account for approximately 3.75 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: capital outlay declines from 783.87 million in fiscal year 2026

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: So this is not simply about buying more equipment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Mas malinaw ang direction, mas nakatutok sa operations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: And there are results that justify continued support.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: In 2025, PIDEA reported that 84% of its PIDEA-initiated arrests

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: And 73.88% of drug-related information and reports

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: acted upon resulted in actual anti-drug operations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Those results show that PIDEA is increasingly directing its work

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: toward higher-value targets and intelligence-driven enforcement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Ang mahalga ngayon ay ituloy at palalimin ang nagawa na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: The next step is to build on those gains

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: It means identifying trafficking routes earlier.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: It means strengthening interdiction before shipment can reach our communities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Sa madaling salita, hindi lang paramihin ang huli,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: That is how the agency's present gains can be translated

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro

segments.text: We can expect stronger interdiction. We can expect closer coordination.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro

segments.speaker: Rep. Marcelino "Marcy" R. Teodoro
segments.text: Mas ligtas ang pamilyang Pilipino. Yan ang sukatan ng pondong ito.

segments.text: while regular appropriations for national sports for all grassroots centerpiece programs

segments.text: the PSC supplements regular line items

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: by drawing from the off-budget National Sports Development Fund

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: automatic remittances from Pagcor gross income shares

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: and inclusive community projects like women in sports,

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: indigenous people's games and Pilipinas para games.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, that will end my interpellation.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Alfredo "Albee" B. Benitez
segments.text: I just would like to do a few clarification.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Alfredo "Albee" B. Benitez
segments.text: Does the Philippine Sports Commission consider,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Alfredo "Albee" B. Benitez
segments.text: for putting them here in the Philippines

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Alfredo "Albee" B. Benitez
segments.text: the transfer of skills can be accessed here in the country?

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Yes, we are very interested and we are pursuing that, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Alfredo "Albee" B. Benitez
segments.text: sikat natin na athletes talagang nag-train abroad eh.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Alfredo "Albee" B. Benitez
segments.text: Tapos doon sila nakakakuha ng mga, uh, well, skills na

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Alfredo "Albee" B. Benitez
segments.text: nagiging, uh, very successful ang kanilang career.

segments.speaker: Rep. Katrina Reiko Chua-Tai
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, next to interpellate the sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Katrina Reiko Chua-Tai
segments.text: I move to recognize Representative Jet Nisay

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Alfredo "Albee" B. Benitez
segments.text: Representative from Pusong Pinoy Party List is recognized.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Good morning, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: A few questions lamang po para po sa PSC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Unang-una ho, pagdating sa grassroots po natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, sa Batang Pinoy na umaabot

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: sa around 15,000 young athletes aged 17 and below

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Paano po natin sinusundan ang kanilang development

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: At ilan sa kanilang eventually napupunta sa national training pool?

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: kasunod po ang Palarong Pambansa sa pag-monitor sa ating mga athletes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Then ang NSA po ang nagsa-check ng mga best performances sa ating mga athletes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: At ang PSC po ay merong youth pool.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: napakalaga po nito dahil hindi nagtatapos sa isang torneo ang talent identification.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Dapat ay may sistema para masundan at ma-develop ang mga atleta na may angking husay at talento.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Ang follow-up question ko lamang ho, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: may centralized talent tracking system po ba ang PSC?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: At may data po ba kung ilan sa mga dating palarumpang bansa at Batang Pinoy athletes ang umabot na sa national level o team?

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Yes po, meron pong tracking yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Ang humahawak po niyan ay ang NSAs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Sanasabit po sa PSC ang mga list ng mga atleta?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: May 44 million plus po sa NEP, sa 27 NEP para sa regional training centers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Ilang centers po ang target nitong ponduhan

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: at saan po sila ilalagay at ilang atlets ang direktang makikinabang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, PSC will support 44, 40 sports

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: At kada sport po, merong tatlong regional training center

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, napakalaga po nito

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: dahil hindi lahat ng promising atlets ay malapit sa Metro Manila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Kung kulang ang regional training infrastructure,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Sa atlets from the provinces na magkaroon

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: ng regular access sa quality training and support.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: ano po ang kriteriya ng PSC

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: sa pagpili ng regions na magkakaroon ng regional training centers?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Nakabatay rin ba ito kung nag-excel ang kada region o probinsya?

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Since Chairman Gregorio took office in July 2025, PSC has established at least 21 locations, project nationwide, covering completed and ongoing centers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: These efforts are urgently being implemented in response to express directive from the Office of the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, may national assessment po ba ang PSC kung ating regions ang underserved in terms of sports facilities and training capacity?

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, si Chairman po ang mismong umiikot sa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: ...bansa natin para pag-inspect at pagtingin sa mga sitwasyon ng kada probinsya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, mas maganda po siguro mas madagdagan pa o mas lakihan pa yung pondo pagdating po sa mga sports center po natin across sa 18 regions po natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: So yung 44 million plus po na to, kulang na kulang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Hindi po doblihin, triplihin o mas lakihan pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, actually, sangayon po ako dyan dahil base po dito sa na-aprubahan ng DBM para sa PSC,

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Pero alam ko po sa ating bagong chairman ng Philippine Sports Commission,

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: po yung kanyang ginagawa at mga achievements, kahit maiksi pa lang ang kanyang panunungkulan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: e marami na pong mga nagawa ng mga regional training centers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Pagdating naman po sa sports as an economic industry,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: ang sports is not only government expenditure,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: maaari rin po itong maging industriya, trabaho at karir for coaches, sportsmen,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: medicine, fitness, events, broadcasting, tourism facilities, and sports equipment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: May national strategy po ba ang PSC para mapalagong sports economy?

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Sa totoo lang po, base kay chairman, dyan po ang talagang isa sa mandato ng PSC coming from the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: creating the Sports Tourism Council to support economic development, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Ang aking follow-up question, nakikipag-coordinate po ba ang PSC with DTI and DOT upang gawing economic activity?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: In major sporting events and sports tourism.

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Ang DOT po, Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, ang DOT po ang tumatayong vice chairman ng NST committee at ang chairman po ang PSC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, may estimate din po ba ang PSC kung ilang jobs and economic activity ang nililika ng major sporting events and sports facilities?

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, sa economic indicator po natin, sa $1 na gastos sa bawat sports tourism, ang balik po niyan ay times 15.

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: According to the Nielsen Report, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Pagdating naman po sa ating athlete safety, lessons from the Baterbonia and Adili tragedy,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, kamakailan lamang po ay nasawi ang ating dalawang student-athletes na si Rene Baterbonia at Divine Adili sa isang team-building activity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Nagpanukala rin po ang inyong lingkod ng House Bill 9892 o ang Local of Campus Activities Safety Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Na layong magkaroon ng safety standards at risk classification ang iba't-ibang off-campus activities ng mga mag-aaral sa ilalim ng DepEd, CHED, TESDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Pero para sa Philippines Sports Commission na may mandato sa athletes welfare at sports development, ano pong specific role ng PSC sa pagtiyak ng kaligtasan ng ating mga atleta, lalo na kapag sila ay kabilang sa school-based sports programs at officially sanctioned activities?

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, nagtatag na po ang PSC ng Stakeholders Committee together with DepEd, CHED, UAAP, SBP, and National Youth Commission.

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: At nabanggit siya po yung nangyaring disgrasya sa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Sa Ateneo, PSC extended P250,000 to each family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Dahil marami pong student-athletes ay mula sa private schools, malinaw po ba kung hanggang saan ng responsibilidad ng PSC, ng school, ng National Sports Association, at ng event organizer kapag may serious injury o fatal accident sa isang sports-related activities?

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, sa mga ganyang sitwasyon po, ang nangunguna po dyan ay ang CHED,

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: sponsoring league, for example, UAAP, and then...

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: PSC is developing a National Athlete and Coaches Code with strong iterations of safe sport principles.

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: It is also backing stronger coaching and safeguarding standards, including the proposed Sports Coaching Act, House Bill 2631,

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: which seeks a national multi-sport coaching accreditation system, a national roster of accredited coaches, continuing education, and stronger safety and competency requirements.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Bilang huling katalungan na lamang po, familiar po ba kayo sa mga tinatawag na pay-to-play in sports pagdating po sa grassroots program po natin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, and sa PSC po, wala po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, gusto ko rin pong itanong ang issue ng play...

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: pay-to-play sa grassroots and youth sports.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Alam po ninyo, marami pong mga organization.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: So, ito po yung mga sports organization na hindi ko po alam kung nakikipag-partner po ba ito sa atin pong Philippine Sports Commission.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Ang nangyayari, malalaking liga, maglalaro ang mga bata, pero kailangan nilang gumastos para sa pang-sarili nilang mga entrance fee, mga uniform, iba't iba pong mga gastos pagdating sa sports program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Ano po kaya yung maaaring tulong?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Ano po kaya yung maaaring tulong ng PSC pagdating ko sa mga problema na nangyayari po sa mga probinsya?

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, yung po bang sinasabi nyo, yung mga nakikita nating mga ligang labas?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Hindi po, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor. Ito po yung mga sports organization na bumababa sa mga iba't-ibang probinsya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Pwedeng basketball, pwedeng volleyball, pwedeng football.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Tapos marami pong magsasali at syempre, malaking gastos kasi yun. Nagbabayad sila ng entrance, ng uniform.

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, tumutulong po ang PSC. Katunayan sa Baguio po ngayon, may bagong liga na supportado ng PSC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Siguro po, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, siguro po mas maganda ma-i-register po natin sila lahat para sa pagkakataon po na mas marami po tayong matulungan po sa across 18 regions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Kasi ito po yung sports program na nauuso ngayon. Marami po halos yung mga magulang gumagastos para makasali lamang yung kanilang anak doon sa paborito nilang sports.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: At, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, I am manifesting my full support para sa Philippine Sports Commission.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Bilang isa ring atleta, napakalaga po ang patuloy na investment natin sa ating bawat atleta at kabataan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Hindi lamang para sa mga medalya, kundi para sa disiplina, kalusugan, oportunidad, at pagbandera ng kanilang galing at talento sa buong mundo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Umaasa po tayo na sa ilalim ng 2027 budget, mas marami pang kabataan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Mas marami pang kabataan na mabigyan ng pagkakataon matuklasan at malinang ang kanilang talento para sa kinabukasan ng Philippine sports sa dangal ng ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: At, higit sa lahat, kailangan, kailangan po ng mas malaking pondo ng PSC para mas marami pong mga kabataan ang ma-involve sa sports, sa kalusugan, at maabot yung kanila pong mga pangarap.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Alfredo "Albee" B. Benitez
segments.text: Okay, could the sponsor, the chair, would like...

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Alfredo "Albee" B. Benitez
segments.text: To clarify, yes, does the sports commission consider organizing sporting events, whether national or international, during festivals of different LGUs, provinces, parang maskara, sinulog, ginagyang, to enhance sports tourism?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Alfredo "Albee" B. Benitez
segments.text: Kine-consider ba ito o ginagawa na?

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker, ginagawa na po ng PSC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: As a matter of fact, two months ago, PSC hosted a Southeast Asian Basketball Juniors in Bacolod City.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Alfredo "Albee" B. Benitez
segments.text: Okay, good to know. Thank you. Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Katrina Reiko Chua-Tai
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, next to interpolate the sponsor, I move to recognize...

segments.speaker: Rep. Katrina Reiko Chua-Tai
segments.text: Representative Sarah Jane Elago from Gabriela Partylist.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Alfredo "Albee" B. Benitez
segments.text: Representative Elago is recognized to interpolate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: As the National Sports Policymaking Body, may we know from the distinguished sponsor how much is the Philippine Sports Commission proposing to fund inclusive, genuine participation and consultation among the sports stakeholders, including our athletes and coaches?

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, around 50 million per annum.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Around 50 million pesos. Is this the original proposal of the PSC?

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, hindi po kasama sa GAA ito. Ito po ay on top of the GAA coming from NSDF.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Alright, so may we know what is the original proposal of the Philippine Sports Commission to ensure that we have wide and broad efforts to consult our sports stakeholders?

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, ang proposed po ng PSC is 100 million pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: 100 million pesos. So nasa kalahati pa lang po yung nakasama dun sa pagtitiyak na hindi lang magawa yung mahalagang konsultasyon, pero matiyak na malawak ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Matitiyak na marinig yung boses ng iba't ibang stakeholders.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Bakit ko ho ito naitanong ngayon, Mr. Speaker?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: The International Labor Organization, or the ILO, adopted its historic...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: the guarantee of health and safety.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: PSC commit that they would include

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na mag-ratify ng ILO Convention na

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: lokal na sitwasyon ng ating sports stakeholders.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at ilalapit rin natin ito sa Department of Labor and Employment

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: dahil mahalaga ang magiging tulungan ng Philippine Sports Commission

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa pagtitiyak ng matagumpay na ratification

segments.speaker: Rep. Katrina Reiko Chua-Tai
segments.text: the sponsor, I move to recognize

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker. Thank you, Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: the budget of the Philippine Sports

segments.speaker: Rep. Katrina Reiko Chua-Tai
segments.text: on the part of the majority,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Alfredo "Albee" B. Benitez
segments.text: The interpellation of the proposed budget

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: I now move to consider the proposed

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Alfredo "Albee" B. Benitez
segments.text: Hearing none, the motion is carried.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Gerardo Jerry Boy J. Espina, Jr.

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: I am pleased to sponsor the

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: fiscal year 2027 budget of Philippine Racing Commission,

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: I am ready to answer any questions from our colleagues.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Presley C. De Jesus of Philreca Party List to interpolate the good sponsor on the proposed budget of the Philippine Racing Commission.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Alfredo "Albee" B. Benitez
segments.text: Representative De Jesus is hereby recognized to interpolate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: konti lang ang tanong ko rito kasi para sa akin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: itong Philippine Racing Commission o horse racing natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: ay isang parte ng kultura natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Congressman Dogok and I filed House Bill number 9386

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: to strengthen the Philippine Racing Commission

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: At alam po natin that the Philippine Racing Commission,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: po ito ng pera sa gobyerno natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: every year. At despite the fact,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: is 20% lang po out of remittance po nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So if we're not going to support this Philippine Racing Commission,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: baka po mawala ang ating kultura.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Kaya po ako ay kaisa po ng Philippine Racing Commission para po mapalakas po natin, kagaya po ng Philippine Sports Commission.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: For that, Mr. Speaker, my first question, under the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Piracom's capital outlays have been reduced to zero from 605,000 for 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: At the same time, its own MOE for general administration and support is reduced from 12 million to 10.5 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Imagine, Mr. Chair, given these reductions, how does Piracom intend to sustain the replacement,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: upgrading, or modernization of its equipment and administrative systems,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: particularly those needed for track inspection,

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, under Special Provision No. 1 of the NEP,

segments.speaker: Rep. Gerardo J. Espina Jr.
segments.text: Piracom relies on off-budget trust receipts derived from the racetrack breakage,

Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I now move to recognize Representative Julienne Jam Baronda, Chairperson and Vice Chairperson of the Committee on Appropriations, to

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: To answer questions on the proposed budget of the Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
segments.text: Representative Jam Baronda is recognized. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished members of this honorable chamber, fellow public servants and partners in public service

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: from the housing sector headed by Secretary Jose Ramon 'Ping' Aliling. Before I proceed, allow me to share an important development in our assessment of the country's housing needs. The country's housing need is not 6.9 million units but

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: only 3.77 million units, as established by the Philippine Statistics Authority's improved methodology. The new framework provides a more precise assessment of actual housing conditions and the different ways these needs may be addressed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: The earlier estimates included households building or repairing their own homes, doubled-up households or families living with another family, newly formed households, and projected housing losses due to calamities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: The refined methodology takes into account the capacity of some families to undertake repairs, rehabilitation or home construction, resulting in a more targeted estimate of 3.76 million housing units.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: This figure should not be viewed as a requirement for the government to build 3.7 million new houses. Addressing housing needs requires both direct and indirect interventions, including affordable housing production, community development, home improvement and accessible financing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: The Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development, under the expanded Pambansang Pabahay para sa Pilipino or 4PH program, is implementing indirect housing programs such as the Enhanced Community Mortgage Program or ECMP and land awards under presidential proclamations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: These efforts address housing needs through secure land tenure and community development without requiring construction of a new housing unit for every family. Equally important is the balance between supply and demand.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Developers provide supply while families and individuals create demand. Developers will only build housing if there are buyers who can afford to purchase homes. This is where Pag-IBIG Fund financing becomes crucial.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Financing now covers both socialized and economic housing, with loan amounts up to 10 million pesos. More families are given the capacity to purchase homes. In turn, stronger demand encourages developers to produce more housing, creating a sustainable cycle of supply and demand. Through the expanded 4PH program, together with Pag-IBIG Fund, local government units, private developers and communities, the government can address housing needs through a combination of housing production, indirect interventions and accessible financing, bringing safe, decent and affordable homes within reach for more Filipino families.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Last year, during the fiscal year 2026 budget deliberation, DHSUD and its key shelter agencies presented the recalibrated and expanded 4PH program. Today, we are pleased to report that the program has gone beyond planning and policy reform into actual housing delivery and contributes significantly to the more than 500,000 housing units delivered, reported by the President in his SONA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Last July. Guided by the vision of President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. and pursuant to Executive Order No. 34, the housing sector adopted a more inclusive, beneficiary-centered and multimodal housing strategy, recognizing that no single housing solution can address the diverse needs of Filipino families.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: In one year of implementation, the expanded 4PH program has transformed from a vertical housing initiative into a comprehensive and inclusive housing platform. It now includes horizontal development and the Enhanced Community Mortgage Program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: It also includes residential proclamation sites, rental housing, modular shelter units, high-density housing, Pag-IBIG Fund and ROPA financing assistance modalities. As of August 2026, the expanded 4PH program generated 135,758 housing units.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: across its various modalities. This represent a significant increase from 1,024 units produced during the first 35 months of the original 4PH program, demonstrating the impact of the reforms and expansion undertaken by the department. These are not merely housing units in the pipeline.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Families are already moving into completed communities. The program has completed 15,543 vertical housing units and 15,775 horizontal housing units, with thousands of families occupying their homes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Access to affordable financing has expanded. As of September 7, 2026, more than 11,700 beneficiary families have availed of housing units under the program, over 70% from the lowest income deciles.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Beyond direct housing production, the department continues to strengthen long-term, sustainable housing delivery through policy, regulatory and institutional reforms. These reforms strengthen the enabling environment for housing production.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: and private sector partners can deliver more housing efficiently and at a greater scale.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: These efforts contribute to the broader housing agenda of this administration,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: which aims to facilitate the production, financing, and provision of 1.13 million housing units

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: With the expanded 4PH program contributing one in every four of these housing units,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: to sustain this momentum, the Department respectfully proposed a fiscal year 2027 budget

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: for housing interest subsidies and program administration and implementation of the expanded 4PH program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: On this note, Mr. Speaker, we thank the Committee on Appropriation and the Committee of Housing

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: and Urban Development for their support and consideration of the Department's budget proposal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: We likewise respectfully seek the support of this Honorable Committee

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: In restoring and strengthening funding for crucial housing intervention necessary the gains of expanded 4-page program

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: and achieve the housing targets of the administration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: This proposed funding will allow the government to continue making housing affordable,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: expanded access to subsidized financing, support vulnerable families, strengthen project implementation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: and accelerate the delivery of housing units nationwide.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Ultimately, Mr. Speaker, the success of our housing program is not measured solely

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: It is measured by the number of Filipino families whose lives are transformed

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: have a safe, secure, and a dignified place to call home.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: With the continued support of this Congress,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: our partner agencies, local government units,

segments.text: we remain committed to building more homes,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: How much has been appropriated and actually disbursed for estate management since the program began?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Gusto ko lang itong estate management since we've been mentioning this.

segments.text: Mr. Speaker, it's 74 million for non-interest.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: 74 million since the inception, yun ba yun?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And who composed of this estate management?

segments.text: Sino ba bang, is this a composition of different members from different organization?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, what project specific project po?

segments.text: Kasi every different project, meron po estate management.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Ito lang, ito lang gusto ko ba ano?

segments.text: Can you define what's estate management?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Para sa akin, it's a foreign language to me.

segments.text: Mr. Speaker, parang kung sa iba po, kung sa kondo parang hoa, kung isa pa pang bahay,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: but sa kondo naman, estate management.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: So, discovered by, yung sinabi ko kanina, use of fire.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, yan po ang tinatawag na estate management.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Para maging klaro lang po, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, gusto ko lang, kasi maraming nanonood sa atin, baka mamaya, siyempre, estate management.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Ako nga, foreign sa akin ito, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: In short, sir Speaker, pag mga pabahay, buwa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Pero pag kondo, siyempre, estate management na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: How many for PH projects, buildings, and beneficiary families are currently covered by state management subsidy?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Of the 11,900, 70% po, Mr. Speaker, of the 11,700, hindi na nga katanggap.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Kasi based po tayo sa DASL 123 po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Who, follow up question, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Who actually receives and administers the subsidy?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: DSA, condominium, corporation, local government unit, developer, or another entity?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, based on the account of each individual, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: What do you mean, each individual?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: We give it to the individual.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Binibigay po yan, Mr. Speaker, yung interest subsidy to the individual.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Parang incorporated po yan, Mr. Speaker, sa loan niya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: What mechanism does the SHUD have to ensure that subsidized buildings are actually being properly maintained?

segments.text: And what happens when the government subsidy eventually ends?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, ano mangyari sa building po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Tinutulungan naman po ng DSUD ang community through social preparation, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: So that on their own, in the future, after 30 years, wala na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Of course, bahay naman nila yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Mas gustuhin mo naman na safe ka, sound, and malinis po ang units po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, nandyan ng DSUD to make sure na talaga ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: For rental housing program naman ng 4PH.

segments.text: potentially providing an alternative for families that may not yet be capable of assuming a long-term housing loan and monthly amortization.
