segments.text: and how it differs from the ownership-based component of PH?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, in short, mayroon pala kayo rental housing program. May program pala ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, for rental housing po, sa government nyo, and then after matapos,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: i-turnover na po sa local government units, sila na po nag-administer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, ang LGU, once being done, transferred to LGU, sila na mag-maintain?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And then, even the ownership ba noon, o hindi lang yung ano lang?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, what are the eligibility requirements, and how does the SHUD determine,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: and validate whether a household actually requires subsidized rental housing?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Actually, Mr. Speaker, ang priority natin dyan is yung mga nasa danger zones,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: and yung LGU din po nag-identify.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: So, the LGU is the one...

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Danger zones, tapos yung mga napektuhan ng programa, proyekto ng gobyerno, yun po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, what are the mechanics of the subsidy?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: How much of the rent is shouldered by the government?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: How much is paid by the bilipasyari?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And for how long can a household receive assistance?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, yung binabayad po nila, rental fee, sobrang mababa na po yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Para lang po yun for the estate management.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: So, definitely po walang kita ang gobyerno natin dyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Actually, hindi ko sinabi yung mga committee gobyerno.

segments.text: How much rent shouldered by the government?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Sila ba may share sila sa pagbayad o wala?

segments.text: Mr. Speaker, yung sinolder po ng government, yung pagawa mismo ng building.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, what is the process for a family to apply for and avail itself of the program?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Ito ba available po sa lahat ng Pilipino or there should be...

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: In LGU kasi na po ang merong...

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Kahit sino, pwede mag-apply o yung mga nasa lay-in muna.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Meron po tayo mechanics. Meron po mechanics ang LGU.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Una is, yun nga, yun na sa danger zone.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Second, yung ma-informal settlers na na-evict sa mga pamamahay nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Third, yung mga nasalanta ng magyo, yung mga dilubyo, yung nasunugan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Like, best example po, dito sa NIA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Nasunog yung babae nila. Ngayon, ginagawa po ng gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Sila din yung po yung titira, yung mga biktima po ng sunog.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: As of today, how many rental housing units have actually been completed and made available for occupancy?

segments.text: And how many families are currently renting units under the program?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, almost 5,000 po. Ginagawa pa lang ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: But next year, first quarter, mag-start na po ng turnover.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: I can be sure because I have it in my district.

segments.text: Mr. Speaker, sa totoo lang po, pag may lupa na available, pag-organize si Homeowners Association, magpapadala po ng member ng board,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda

segments.text: So, wala pong problema po sa beneficiary, basta po, kompleto, in compliance po sa mga requirement.

segments.text: Pag nagkakasundo po sa presyo, posible po na magbibigyan ng importansya ni SHFC.

segments.text: What is good with this, meron po silang dalawang team.

segments.text: Una, yung appraisal. Second, yung member po ng board or yung komposisyon po ng engineer, architects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda

segments.text: Kaya po, importante talaga for LGU, for local government units sa area na sila mismo tutulungan po yung hoa nila makumplay yung mga dokumento na needed po.

segments.text: and how many had already been identified,

segments.text: organized or processed before they were included under the 4PH banner?

segments.text: And meron pa po yung naka-next in line sa pipeline po for this year.

segments.text: So next in line meron pa?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Pero Mr. Speaker, sa totoo lang, ang challenge po dun sa WHOAS

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: is hindi po nila kaya i-organize yung mga members nila.

segments.text: But that is why, kaya po si D. Sud nandoon na rin

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: para tutulungan din yung local members nila.

segments.text: was provided under 4PH that warrants counting them

segments.text: Actually po, Mr. Speaker, sa enhanced mortgage program,

segments.text: yan po yung bagong programa ngayon ng SHFC.

segments.text: Particularly when the acquisition of the property is financed

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, as what I've said po, Mr. Speaker,

segments.text: Kasi una, marami din request sa buong Pilipinas.

segments.text: Especially po, ako, tip ko sa lahat,

segments.text: I have nothing to do with this.

segments.text: again, you already answered that, no?

segments.text: Mr. Secretary, sa totoo, ah, Mr. Speaker, sa totoo lang,

segments.text: Oo, kaya pagkausap mo, alam na nila lahat ng mga solusyon.

segments.text: Ako may problema kasi yung mga RD kinukuha, ginagawang Yusek, Mr. Speaker.

segments.text: Tingin mo? Are we? Of course.

Rep. Sittie Shahara "Bai Dimple" I. Mastura

segments.text: Magandang hapon sa ating lahat, especially to the housing family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: I hope the housing family have all with houses.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker. Thank you, Madam Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Uunahin ko na lang yung pinakamalapit sa puso ko na tanong na for two years may concern.

segments.text: Kasi kung layan man ka, katulad ko, tapos bahay mo walang kuryente, medyo very ironic yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: hindi ko na lang itatanong yung detalye.

segments.text: especially po sa mga different areas, si NHA po, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Meron ding appropriate areas for horizontal, and meron appropriate areas for vertical, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Naalala ko dati sa Quezon City, nung unang, when I was still a city councilor, dahil maraming tao ang gusto ng horizontal,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Na ginawa nung, ng Quezon City government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: In fact, at the time, I was espousing for vertical construction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Because the truth is, ang lupa, nauubos ang tao, hindi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Ang lupa, tumataas yung presyo over time, ang tao dumarami.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: And merong law of supply and demand.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: While I understand na maraming tao sa probinsya, maaaring gusto yung horizontal,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: but, di ba, minsan, we have to prepare for the eventuality, eh, na mauubos yung mga lupa natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: at hindi natin mabibigyan ng sapat na pabahay ang mga nangangailangan ng bahay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Madam Speaker, kaya po nag-fail yung una, kasi pinipilit nila yung vertical.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Kaya nagka-problema tayo in some areas, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: look at, ewan ko kung doon tayo nag-fail. Later on, babalik ako dyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Families actually provided housing. Target was 72.5%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: NHA missed the target by 19 percentage points.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Vacant and unawarded housing. This is very telling.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Merong problema sa housing ang mga Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Pero, 84% ng ready housing units, hindi naman mabigyan ng housing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: In fact, babalik ako dyan sa, ano...

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: I went to look at the site sa Rizal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Ano yun, eh. Horizontal housing units yung mga naka...

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: In fact, ang inabutan ko doon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: I think the target was a total of 1,000 units.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: ang dami ng mga housing units,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: In fact, nasisira na yung mga ibang units.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: And, it's not only in Rizal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: It has happened in various other places.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: I was with Mayor Junjun Inariz, eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: And, in fact, okay na sa kanya, eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Totoo, ang mga local government units,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Madam Speaker, meron po ngayon provincial resolution that they will really not accept. In province lang, talaga accept na lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Kagaya ang sinabi mo, meron na ngayon. I'm talking about nung wala pa yung resolution na yun. And assuming na I would agree with what you said,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: e di sana binigay na lang natin yung mga pabahay dun sa mga tigarizal, imbis na nasira yung mga housing units na iwan na unoccupied.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Madam Speaker, yun na po yung nangyari ngayon. Binigay na lang sa tigarizal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: The reason why I'm asking these questions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Because we have to face actual facts. We should not sugarcoat it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Kasi kung, if we do not recognize a problem, then we will not be able to come up with a solution.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Masasayang ang pera na, masasayang yung pabahay, yung oras na ginugol para gawin yung pabahay na yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Tapos hindi natin nababawasan yung mga taong nangangailangan ng tirahan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Diba? That's my point, Madam Chair, our good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Because if we do not provide a fallback to this, alam ko meron tayong mga guidelines na gustong gawin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: But as I mentioned, for practicality purposes, based on what is actually happening, if we just look at it really,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: then makikita natin napakadaming pabahay na sasayang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: In fact, naalala ko, during the time of former president,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: President Duterte, nakalimutan ko ano yung mga nag-occupy dun sa mga pabahay na hindi pa nabibigyan ng beneficiary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Sino ba yun? Yung group that occupied yung mga housing units?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Maybe NHA would know, or they should.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Kadamay, diba? Dahil anong sinabi nila, anong binigay nilang reason?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Kaya naman yung mga unit, ang tagal-tagal nang nakatiwangwang, ang tagal-tagal nang walang occupant,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: eh, tutal, ayaw nyo naman ibigay sa beneficaryo, eh, o-occupy na namin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Kaya, that was a problem before, and that remained a problem up to now.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So that, as we construct units, we are able to...

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: put a family in this unit, para-housing units, para naman nagagamit na nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Sa ngayon, from 5,000 units, 2,000 na lang un-unoccupied, at saka sa in-city na lang, in-province na lang yung beneficiary po ng NHA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Now, the things that kailangan natin maayos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: As I mentioned, yung utilization, not only of the funds given to the SHUD,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: but yung utilization ng actual housing units na readily available.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Pangalawa, there is also a problem with collection efficiency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Target was 50% collection, but actual target was 27%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: If NHA cannot collect efficiently revolving housing resources, will deteriorate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: What improvements have we taken to improve collection efficiency?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Madam Speaker, kasi una, may mga moratorium pag may bagyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Especially ngayon na may problema tayo sa pagtaas ng crudo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Kaya po yun yung problema, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Yung collection efficiency, yung tinatanong ko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: What steps has the agency taken to improve collection efficiency?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Madam Speaker, meron na po ngayon silang online payment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Yung online, dati kasi you have to sisigilin mo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: It's a welcome innovation that we agree with online payments.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: But as we all know, the problem is not kung magbabayad ka ng physically o magbabayad ka ng online.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: The problem really, it's really a collection problem.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Dahil meron talagang mga binipisaryo, ang kailangan mong pupuntahan para makulektahan mo ng pambayad eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: They will not do it voluntarily.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Diba, sa atin na lang eh, hindi na bahay ah, sa cellphone.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Diba, dati pwede ka mag-accumulate ng utang sa cellphone bill mo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Kita mo ngayon, ang ginagawa ng mga provider.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Puputulin yung linya mo para mapilitang kang magbayad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: So, NHA, ano bang kailangan nyo gawin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Kasi hindi daw kayo na baka nag-i-evi, kaya hindi nagbabayad din yung mga owners.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: But, you know, kailangan siguro ano, i-improve na lang yung collections.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: And we'll need to make sure that intensify na lang ni NHA yung collections nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Actually, yun yung point ko, good sponsor, is what steps has the agency taken to improve yung collection efficiency

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: given its past experience of poor collection efficiency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Madam Speaker, sa totoo lang, natatawa na lang kami.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Hindi naman natin pwede kayo napalis yung mga tao na hindi nagbabayad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Sa pag-ibig, pinabales. 97%. Dito sa NHC, hindi. But anyway, the department, the agency will try their best through third-party collection agent na lang po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: As I mentioned, good speaker, good sponsor. I know we all know for a fact that collecting, especially kung hihintayin natin yung voluntary payment, it will really truly become difficult.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: But through the years, alam na natin that there's a collection problem. But we cannot leave it as is na hindi kami gagawa ng bagong proseso to improve yung collection.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: As I mentioned, the department uses the money as part of yung revolving fund so that it could be reused for other beneficiaries. Pero kung hindi talaga, kung wala talaga tayong gagawin, then we will not be able to serve a broader number of people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I will move ahead.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Madam Speaker, they will try their best na lang to improve the manner of collection through third-party. Meron naman sila third-party collectors. Problema, hindi talaga takot ang mga tao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: But again, we will call the attention of the NHA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Ang dami ng measure, Madam Speaker, may expanded convenient payment, may paymaya, may land bank, may link bank, engaged private collection service providers, take-out mechanism of receivables with pag-iwig, implement cancellation, reward of accounts, strength and on-site collection, timely billing, distribution of demand letters, strength and regular monitoring analysis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: There are the things na ginawa po ng NHA.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: With the indulgence of our distinguished sponsor and our distinguished colleague, we have one more minute. So please wrap up.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Well, with regards to housing construction, the target was 2,338. Actual accomplished was 949. That's roughly 40.6% of the target.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So, what steps are we taking to improve itong ano?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Madam Speaker, saan po yung area na yun?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So that we could reach yung construction target na kailangan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Madam Speaker, yung construction target, saan po yan? Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: I got it from yung performance data ng NHA at saka yung sinupply ng...

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Madam Speaker, para matapos po pondo, kailangan ng NHA. Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: No, eh, di ba, private ka yung gumagawa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: For example, for the balance housing, during the briefing of COA, COA required this should to reassess developer obligations way back, hanggang 2018 nga, pinareassess.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: According to the DOJ findings summarized in the briefing, the formula.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Effectively reduce the required contribution to 25% of the statutory amount and permitted 15%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So, tanong ko nga, how much should have been collected by this should?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Madam Speaker, for this should po, balance housing.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: With the indulgence of our distinguished colleague, will that be the last question?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So, what are we going to do? There's around 60 billion uncollected.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: So, paano natin ko connect ahin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Madam Speaker, mayroong moratorium until February.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: So, after February, if we will not extend the moratorium, we will collect.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: So, paano natin ko connect ahin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So, pero until February, nakukulektahan. Pero meron na ba? How much has already been collected?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Around 15 billion, yun ba? Or 15%? Which is which?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: 15 billion was collected and there's a balance of 60 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: And we only have until February.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Madam Speaker, that's moratorium. After February, makulekta na po yung 45 billion.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Distinguished sponsor, can you provide in writing the details also?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Yes, ganun na lang, Madam Speaker. Can I be provided with the actual data collection efficiency?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: So, the distinguished sponsor is hereby directed to provide answers to the queries of the Honorable Suntay in writing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Yes, Madam Speaker. We will do.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: And lastly, Madam Speaker, can I also have a breakdown?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: NHA, madaming lupa, madaming property ang NHA. In fact, dun lang sa Quezon City.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: There are a lot of NHA-owned properties. Most of them nga, madami ng informal settlers ang nag-o-occupy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Which could be used for talagang socialized housing. Decent affordable housing for them.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Do we get that commitment, Madam Sponsor?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: You have the commitment, Honorable Suntay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Thank you very much, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Thank you very much. Majority Leader?

segments.text: Madam Speaker, next to interpellate the sponsor, I move to recognize Representative Edgar R. Erice from the 2nd District of Caloocan City.

segments.speaker: Rep. Katrina Reiko Chua-Tai
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move to withdraw my earlier motion.

segments.text: Madam Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor, I just have a few questions for the D-SUDE family.

segments.text: Unang katanungan ko po, mayroon po bang nakalaang pondo ang D-SUDE?

segments.text: Madam Speaker, wala po. Kaya humihingi po ngayon sa 2027 budget, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Actually, Madam Speaker, dahil sinabi po niyang wala pong pondo para doon, hindi ko na po itatanong yung pangalawa, pangatlo at pangapat kong katanungan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: I want to commend the good sponsor for yielding to the questions of my colleagues in the minority

segments.text: and I wish my colleagues in the Congress will guarantee a budget for the desude

segments.text: that is responsive to the needs of the Filipino people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: And ang ahensya na nagtutugon sana ng pangangailangan ng ating mga mamamayan para sa pabahay,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: para sa mga nagkaroon ng sakuna, nagkaroon ng sunog,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ay sana po malagyan po natin ng prioridad, malagyan po natin ng sapat na pondo

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: para po matugunan ang pangangailangan ng ating mga mamamayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Since there are no other members of the minority,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Wini-withdraw ko po ang sinabi ko po kanina, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: At dahil po dyan, wala na po akong magiging katanungan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ipapasa ko na po kay ginaong Kongresista.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Thank you very much, ang ating kinatawan sa Akbayan Party List.

segments.text: Madam Speaker, next to interpolate the sponsor,

segments.text: Ang usapin ng pabahay ay hindi lamang tungkol sa...

segments.text: And resilient urban design development guidelines, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: At ano po ang mga priority areas

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Those who are at the danger zones area,

segments.text: especially under project nung mga Madam Speaker.
